invariants: no damage is applied to a missing or destroyed object
damage grows linearly with the hit speed
the damage kind is always impact
collision and impact use the same formula with different multipliers

state.description: datablock: hit speed that deals 1x the multiplier
state.name: min_impact_speed

state.description: per object, read only here: Enabled, Disabled or Destroyed
state.name: damage_state

summary: Impact damage for shape datablocks. When an object that still exists and is not destroyed is hit (a physics collision or a scripted impact), it takes 'impact' damage proportional to the hit speed divided by the datablock's minimum impact speed, applied at the object's position offset back along the hit vector. Collisions and impacts differ only in their damage multiplier.
